item.title: [LU-20387] Ubuntu 26.04 parallel-scale test_metabench: bind on local address failed

emoly.liu  yujian It doesn't seems to be a problem of Lustre, but a problem of MPI running on Ubuntu 26.04.

The address in the log "bind on local address (fd33:3981:3213:f010:0:5254:1c:f986:0)" is an IPv6 address, and I wonder whether IPv6 is used in our network?

If IPv6 is not used, disable it on vms would be a good way to solve this problem.

Thank you, xiwang.
